title: Seedance 2.5 US Reference to Video
description: US-hosted ByteDance Seedance 2.5 generates video with native audio from up to 30 images, 10 videos, and 10 audio references. Supports reference-guided generation, video editing, and extension at 480p, 720p or 1080p.

pricing.text: For every second of 720p video you generate, you will be charged roughly $0.5676/second, and for 480p you will be charged $0.2646/second, and for every second of 1080p video, you will be charged roughly 1.396278 per second. Your request will cost $0.02568 per 1000 tokens for 480p and 720p, and $0.02808 per 1000 tokens for 1080p. The number of tokens is given by (height of output video * width of output video * (input video duration + output video duration) * 24) / 1024. If video inputs are provided the price is multiplied by 0.6. With video inputs and 720p resolution, the price is roughly $0.34056 per second.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: The text prompt used to generate the video. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: task
inputs.tooltip: The type of video generation task. Reference uses the supplied media as guidance. Editing modifies a reference video and automatically coerces aspect_ratio and duration to auto. Extension continues a reference video and automatically coerces aspect_ratio to auto.

inputs.name: image
inputs.tooltip: Reference images to guide video generation. Refer to them in the prompt as @Image1, @Image2, etc. Supported formats: JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP, TIFF, GIF, HEIC, HEIF. Max 30 MB per image. Up to 30 images. Total files across all modalities must not exceed 50. Each socket may carry a batch; they are sent in socket order (the first picture of socket 1 is number 1).

inputs.name: video
inputs.tooltip: Reference videos to guide video generation. Refer to them in the prompt as @Video1, @Video2, etc. Supported formats: MP4, MOV. Up to 10 videos. Each video must be 1.8 to 30.2 seconds and no larger than 200 MB; combined duration must not exceed 30.2 seconds. Dimensions must be 300 to 6,000 pixels per side, aspect ratio 0.4 to 2.5, and frame rate 24 to 60 FPS. Each socket may carry a batch; they are sent in socket orde

inputs.name: audio
inputs.tooltip: Reference audio to guide video generation. Refer to them in the prompt as @Audio1, @Audio2, etc. Supported formats: MP3, WAV. Up to 10 files. Each file must be 1.8 to 30.2 seconds and no larger than 15 MB; combined duration must not exceed 30.2 seconds. Each socket may carry a batch; they are sent in socket order (the first picture of socket 1 is number 1).

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.tooltip: Video resolution - 480p for faster generation, 720p for balance, 1080p for high quality.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.tooltip: Duration of the video in seconds. Supports 4 to 30 seconds, or auto to let the model decide based on the prompt.

inputs.name: aspect_ratio
inputs.tooltip: The aspect ratio of the generated video. Use 16:9 for landscape, 9:16 for portrait/vertical, 1:1 for square, 21:9 for ultrawide cinematic, or auto to let the model decide.

inputs.name: generate_audio
inputs.tooltip: Whether to generate synchronized audio for the video, including sound effects, ambient sounds, and lip-synced speech. The cost of video generation is the same regardless of whether audio is generated or not.

inputs.name: bitrate_mode
inputs.tooltip: Output bitrate mode. 'high' requests a higher-quality, larger-file encode from the model; 'standard' uses the default bitrate.

inputs.name: codec
inputs.tooltip: 'auto' retains default video codec behaviour; 'H264' uses H.264; 'H265' uses H.265.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.tooltip: Random seed for reproducibility. Note that results may still vary slightly even with the same seed. -1 leaves it to the model.
